fields.name: student_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the student.

fields.name: institution_name
fields.description: Name of the college or educational body issuing the transcript.

fields.name: student_id_number
fields.description: Institution-specific ID assigned to the student.

fields.name: date_of_issue
fields.description: Date the transcript was officially generated.

fields.name: program_of_study
examples: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
fields.description: Major, degree, or course of study.

fields.name: cumulative_gpa
fields.description: Overall grade point average for the student.

fields.name: courses
examples: CS101: Intro to Programming (A), MATH201: Calculus II (B+)
fields.description: List of courses with grades, may be partial or complete.

fields.name: official_seal_signature
fields.description: Registrar or authorized signature plus the institutional seal.

document.document_description: An academic transcript is an official record of a student’s courses, grades, and credit hours earned at an educational institution. It is commonly used for admissions, job applications, and professional licensing requirements.
